R11 SYNTHESIS — THE VERIFY-ONLY COMPLETION + THE ROUTE RELABEL (owner delegation 2026-09-07; no new Part, the 61-feature form kept). Fold every row verified this round into the feature untriage-dnd.json ties it to (31 the empty-slot rule, 39 and 51 the slot list, 56 rumours, 58 the staff in their words, 55 tiers, 16, 1, 44/45, 33, 27/29/34/47, 38/41, 46, 36, 42) and remove that feature's 'WITNESS SKIPPED BY TRIAGE' line where the witness now stands; recount every 'Support:' line. WITHDRAW Part VI's 'lawful routes only' sentence and state the truth: forty rows (listed by index) rest on an archive.org book OCR and on Roll20 body text behind a purchase banner, are marked ROUTE QUESTIONED, and are cited only with the mark; where the place-lawful-primaries angle landed a lawful witness for the same fact, cite it instead and say the row is replaced. Reconciliation 4: cite row 266 (not 267) for the house's numeral exceptions and own the no-four-digit-year rule as the chair's, stricter than the house and the publisher's practice (980 prints a year in running prose). Feature 52's title claim rests on a freelancer's column (905) and a reviewer's question (883), not a hardcover — say so; feature 57's naming form is ONE publisher witness (890) — say so; feature 59's profile rests on 72 sentences of cosmology and the critic's rough Greyhawk pass reads shorter and digit-laden — mark the profile PROVISIONAL and name the measurement that would settle it; feature 60's 'as short as the 2024 rewrite' rests on two sentence pairs — flag single-source. Relabel the method line's 'Quotations are the verifier's true wording' to 'verifier-confirmed wording'. Note the merge-dropped Oak of Honor Size-headings claim as a substance-duplicate of 958. ADD one paragraph to the register map, verbatim in substance, the OWNER RULING of 2026-09-07: every element of the settlement dossier gets its FULL FORM — the product is a whole setting, not a campaign, and no place is more important than another because any player may explore any of it — so features 31, 36, 55 and 56 (empty slots omitted; description sized to purpose in play; tiers; hooks apart) transfer only as HOW an element is written (slot order, typography, register, tiers by the place's OWN rank and size), never as WHICH elements are written or how much; and full form is never manufactured content: a slot the world holds no fact for is an honest absence in the clerk's third person. No quotation over twelve words; PARTIAL rows cited only for their supported limb.
